summary: Postinstall and require-time beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package ships a beacon.cjs that POSTs installer host identifiers — os.hostname(), __dirname (install path), process.cwd(), and process.version — to the hardcoded bare-IP HTTP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc. The beacon fires from the declared postinstall lifecycle script and also from the main entry on require(), so both `npm install` and any subsequent import trigger the outbound POST without user interaction. The package provides no advertised functionality: index.js exports a Proxy whose property accesses return no-ops, and the only runtime side effect is the beacon call. The package self-describes as a 'compatibility shim' and uses a long placeholder-shaped name, matching the shape of a dependency-confusion reconnaissance canary that fingerprints internal CI and developer hostnames.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
